title: Stormwind City
body: Stormwind is the capital of the human kingdom of the same name and the chief stronghold of the Alliance, raised in white stone above the northwest coast. The Horde burned the old city in the First War. It rose again by the labor of the Stonemasons' Guild, with money raised by Archbishop Alonsus Faol and help from King Terenas of Lordaeron. Canals divide its districts, from the Trade District and Cathedral Square to the poor streets of Old Town, and Stormwind Keep, seat of the House of Wrynn, looks over it all.

parts.body: A boy, Anduin Wrynn, sits on the throne of Stormwind, and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs as regent in his name.
King Varian Wrynn has come home after long years lost and sits on his throne again, and ships sail from the harbor below the city for Northrend.

sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormwind_City (founding, First War, rebuilding by Stonemasons, Church of Light and Terenas, districts, Deeprun Tram)

title: Valley of Heroes
body: The Valley of Heroes is the southern approach to Stormwind, where a stone bridge crosses the moat to the city gates. Along the road stand statues of five leaders of the Alliance Expedition that marched into Draenor: Khadgar, Turalyon, Alleria Windrunner, Danath Trollbane and Kurdran Wildhammer. Each plaque calls its hero presumed dead and carries a farewell from a comrade or kin. Here too the Field Marshal proclaims the Alliance's great victories to the city.

title: Stormwind Harbor
body: Stormwind Harbor spreads along the sea below the city, a fortified port of tiered docks, cannons and steam tanks. It was made ready for the war against the Lich King: when the Scourge struck at the city here, King Varian and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon directed the defense from its walls. Now the Kraken carries soldiers to Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra, while The Bravery still sails for Auberdine in Darkshore.

title: King Varian Wrynn
body: Varian Wrynn was a boy when the orcs sacked Stormwind and his father, King Llane, was assassinated. Raised in exile in Lordaeron, he came home to rule the rebuilt city, married Tiffin and had a son, only to lose his queen to a riot in the streets. Then he vanished, and his kingdom was ruled in his name by a regent.

parts.body: Stripped of his memory, Varian fought far away as a gladiator called Lo'Gosh before winning back his past, his name and his throne.

When Bolvar Fordragon's shield was laid before him after the Wrathgate, Varian called the loss his own fault and swore to purge the evil of the Horde from the world. Peace, he says now, has cost his people their greatest heroes.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Varian_Wrynn (youth, exile, Tiffin, abduction, Lo'Gosh, Onyxia unmasked, Wrathgate)

parts.body: Even so he honored the letter Tirion Fordring sent with the death knights of the Ebon Blade, and pledged that Stormwind would fight beside them against the Lich King.

title: Prince Anduin Wrynn
body: Anduin Wrynn, son of King Varian and the late Queen Tiffin, was named for the hero Anduin Lothar and for his grandfather Llane. He was crowned young, and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governed as regent in his name. He is a quiet, thoughtful boy, gentle where his father is fierce.

parts.body: With his father home, the crown is King Varian's again, and the boy who wore it is a prince and heir once more.
When Lady Prestor was unmasked as the dragon Onyxia, she seized the boy and carried him off, and he was saved only when his father's thrown blade loosened her grip.

title: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
body: A paladin of the Silver Hand, Bolvar Fordragon was named regent of Stormwind for the boy king Anduin while King Varian was lost, and through the long years of the regency he governed from Stormwind Keep, with the noblewoman Lady Katrana Prestor ever at his side.

parts.body: Her counsel was a chain. When Lady Prestor was unmasked as the dragon Onyxia, it came out that a medallion she had placed around his neck had held him captive, her puppet.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Bolvar_Fordragon (Silver Hand, regent, Drakefire Amulet, Valiance Expedition, Wrathgate)

parts.body: When Varian returned, Bolvar took up the sword again and led the Alliance north against the Lich King. Fordragon Hold in the Dragonblight bears his name.
At the Wrathgate the Forsaken traitor Putress loosed his plague on Alliance and Horde alike, and the red dragons burned the field clean. Bolvar's body was never found; only his shield came home.

title: Master Mathias Shaw
body: Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, the kingdom's intelligence service, from its barracks in Old Town, and likes to call himself master of all assassins. Few shady dealings in the city escape him, and his agents keep watch on the Defias in Westfall.

parts.body: When no court will touch a well connected lord, Shaw swallows his pride and sends for help from the cheesemonger Elling Trias, whose friends act where SI:7 cannot.
Of five agents he sent into the Eastern Plaguelands after strange Forsaken activity, one came back, and died in his sleep after uttering two words: Nathanos and Blightcaller.

sources: quest 394 reward text (master of all assassins)

title: Archbishop Benedictus
body: Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light from the Cathedral of Light. In his youth he studied under Archbishop Alonsus Faol, who raised great sums to rebuild Stormwind after the Second War, and he helped raise the cathedral that stands as a monument to his teacher before succeeding him at the head of the Church. Tainted Eyes of Paleth, made by human priests long ago, are brought to him to be cleansed.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Archbishop_Benedictus (pupil of Faol, built the Cathedral, succeeded him)
notes: Rewritten 2026-10-25 for the reorganization pilot: shorter, context first.

title: Baros Alexston
body: Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind, keeps his office at City Hall in Cathedral Square. He grew up on his family's farm in Westfall, since burned and taken by thieves, and as a young man joined the Stonemasons' Guild that rebuilt the city. When the work was done he accepted the post of city architect, and he has served Stormwind ever since.

parts.body: When an unsent letter from Edwin VanCleef reached him after the Kingpin's death, Baros called his old comrade an idealist and a romantic consumed by revenge, yet admitted he could not entirely blame him.

sources: quest 393 description (Shaw owes me a favor)

title: Elling Trias
body: Elling Trias runs Trias' Cheese in the Trade District with his wife and son, and will gladly offer a taste of cheddar or Darnassian bleu. Those who know better come for something else: behind the counter lies a quiet web of friends and contacts that reaches from Stormwind Keep to Darkshire and beyond. When the kingdom's own agents cannot act, Trias can, and he prefers his justice swift and off the record.
sources: quest 1242 request text (cheddar and Darnassian bleu)
